name: 纳米三防牛仔背带雪裤（黑色）
description:
黑色老花牛仔背带雪裤，白色明线，酷酷的工装感，配什么外套都好看。只租背带裤，图里的外套不包含；只有黑色。尺码 L。

## 面料与科技
- 纳米三防牛仔面料：防水、防油、防污

## 设计细节
- 背带款，护住后腰不进雪
- 胸前口袋 + 侧边大工装口袋
- 白色对比明线，满身老花暗纹
- 宽松阔腿版型，裤脚可收口
descriptionEn:
Black monogram denim bib snow pants with white contrast stitching — a cool workwear look that goes with any jacket. Bib pants only (the jacket in the photos isn't included); black only. Size L.

## Fabric & Technology
- Nano-treated denim that repels water, oil and stains

## Design Details
- Bib style keeps snow out of your lower back
- Chest pocket plus big cargo pockets on the sides
- White contrast stitching over a subtle all-over monogram
- Relaxed wide-leg fit with gathered cuffs
